sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid ndoo1242 and its 7 references; subgroup memb1239 (205 refs)
sources.note: Bibliographic only: Banga 1978; Bokula & Irumu 1994; Demolin & Soquet 1999; Tucker & Bryan 1966; Kadima et al. 2008; Nzita & Niwampa 1997; Dundas 1910 (Baringo, irrelevant). Subgroup refs are Mamvu/Balese/Efe works (Vorbichler, Smith, Schebesta), none Ndo-specific.

sources.citation: Ethnologue 24th ed. (2021) 'Kebu [ndp]' (Internet Archive copy) and Ethnologue 9th-16th ed. snippets on archive.org
sources.note: Names (Ke'bu, Kebu'tu, Ndo, Ndu, Okebu), dialects (Avari, Oke'bu, Membi), classification, NT 1977-1992; no linguistic description; no phonology resource noted.

sources.citation: Demolin, Didier & Teston, Bernard. 1997. Phonetic characteristics of double articulations in some Mangbutu-Efe languages. Proc. Eurospeech 1997 (Rhodes), 803-806. DOI 10.21437/Eurospeech.1997-269.
sources.note: Concerns Mamvu, Lese and Efe only (not Ndo); acoustic/aerodynamic study of labial-velar and labial-uvular stops; nothing on stress or tone.

sources.citation: Bokula, Moiso & Irumu, Agozia K. 1994. Bibliographie et matériaux lexicaux des langues Moru-Mangbetu (Soudan-Central, Zaïre). Annales Aequatoria 15: 203-245.
sources.note: Sec. III 'Sous-groupe Mangbutu' (pp. 226-234): 'La langue membi est connu aussi sous le nom de "ndo"'; only source listed is Van Geluwe 1957 pp. 15-18, 100-101; a 4-language comparative lexicon (lese/mamvu/mangbutu/membi) with tone marks (haut, moyen, montant, descendant; convention pp. 204-205). Nothing on stress or accent; Membi informant = Banga Dokery (teacher, 32, Biringi).

sources.citation: Tucker, A. N. & Bryan, M. A. 1956. The Non-Bantu Languages of North-Eastern Africa (Handbook of African Languages III). London: OUP for IAI. pp. 6-7 (NDO Dialect Cluster) and the Moru-Mangbetu introduction.
sources.note: Group-level handbook with occasional tone/stress remarks per group; snippets show only the dialect inventory for Ndo, the surrounding text was not recoverable.

sources.citation: Czekanowski, Jan. 1924. Forschungen im Nil-Kongo-Zwischengebiet, Bd. VI/2 (archive.org forschungenimnil02czek scanned)
sources.note: a full-text search for stress/accent Kebu/Okebu/Membi: no relevant material (volume covers the interlacustrine region).

sources.citation: Banga, Yey Dokery. 1978. Éléments de la grammaire générative et transformationnelle du membitu (ndo). Mémoire, Institut Supérieur Pédagogique, Kisangani.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained

sources.note: The only dedicated grammatical description of Ndo (Membitu) that Glottolog lists; a Kisangani mémoire of this type normally opens with a phonological sketch that would state tone and possibly accent.

sources.citation: Kadima, Kamuleta et al. 2008. Situation linguistique en Afrique Centrale: La République Démocratique du Congo, nouvelle édition. Kinshasa/Yaoundé: CERDOTOLA.

sources.note: Congolese atlas that lists per-language bibliographies; may point to further Kisangani/Kinshasa theses on Ndo (Okebu/Membitu) beyond Banga 1978.
